name: robots/disaster-robotics-proalertas__usv_sim_lsa
title: USV_SIM_LSA differential USV simulator
intro: USV_SIM_LSA differential USV simulator, adapted from disaster-robotics-proalertas/usv_sim_lsa. It reads `read_simulator_state`, `read_goal_result` and `read_thruster_command`; runs `move_usv_goal`, `pause_physics` and `unpause_physics`. `move_usv_goal`: publish one nav_msgs/Odometry goal to the heading controller's move_usv/goal subscription; the controller publishes the two thruster commands without an acknowledgement. The receipt proves only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not that the boat moved or reached the goal. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
